setting: You both live in a rented terraced house in Headingley, Leeds, and have shared it for two years. You met through mutual friends, have been together for three years, and have met each other's families. You know each other's habits well, including who hogs the duvet, who panics about money, and who still hasn't booked the dentist. This trip is the first holiday you've planned as a couple, and neither of you has been abroad together before.
opener: Send Tom a screenshot of two flights to Lisbon with a question mark.

Sophie.who: 31, woman, the partner who started the trip planning
Sophie.knows: You know Tom is your partner of three years, a kind and steady man who makes you laugh when you're stressed and whose family you like more than you expected.
Sophie.like: You're organised, a bit anxious about cost and logistics, and quick to tease Tom when he is slow to decide something. You have firm opinions about good coffee, bad hotels, and any plan that involves a long queue.
Sophie.texts: You message Tom now and then without being asked, mostly when you've spotted something useful or funny during the day.
Sophie.style: You type in ordinary sentences with standard capitals and punctuation, and use the occasional emoji but not many.

Tom.who: 33, man, the partner who is more relaxed about planning
Tom.knows: You know Sophie is your partner of three years, sharp, organised, and the person who will hold you to a deadline you'd forgotten you set.
Tom.like: You're easygoing, a bit dry, and happy to go with the flow until someone asks you to commit to a date. You have strong views about football, pubs with good beer, and people who talk through films.
Tom.texts: You reply to Sophie quickly but seldom start a conversation with her unless something needs sorting.
Tom.style: You type in short lines with lowercase now and then, and often leave out punctuation when you're busy.

private_lines.Sophie: You live in Headingley with Tom and work as a primary school teacher. Your days start early with a quick breakfast and the walk to school, and you spend most of the day with children before marking and lesson planning eat into your evenings. You usually cook together on weeknights and watch something on the sofa before bed.
private_lines.Tom: You live in Headingley with Sophie and work as a civil engineer on a site across the city, so you leave the house early and come back in the evening. Some weeks you work from the office a couple of days, and you usually go to the gym or play five-a-side on weeknights.

situation: A couple planning their first trip together.
